data.title: Order to remove green waste (Ordnungsverfügung)
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt's public order office (Ordnungsamt) ordered you to completely remove green waste dumped on the city green space behind your property at Lindenweg 12 by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) with expected costs of €480.00.
data.explanation: The city says garden waste was dumped on the public green space behind your property and orders you to clear it all by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city may have it removed by a contractor and charge you, expected at €480.00. You may also decide to challenge the order by filing a court action (Klage) at the administrative court; there is no prior objection procedure. The app shows the deadline for this. Consider getting legal advice if you disagree, for example if the waste is not yours.

items.title: Remove green waste
items.action: Completely remove the green waste dumped on the city green space behind Lindenweg 12.
items.consequence: The city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) at your expense, expected cost €480.00.
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026

items.title: Deadline to file court action (Klage)
items.action: Decide whether to file an action at the Administrative Court of Musterstadt, in writing or recorded at the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
